set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system radius-server 2001:db8::1:1.explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

port 1645.explanation: Configures the RADIUS server with `[parameter1]` as the server address and `[parameter2]` as the port number for authentication and accounting communication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: Port number for the RADIGUS server.

secret \"132B0B124F0E\".explanation: Configure the IP address, port and shared key of the RADIUS server.

accounting-port 1646.explanation: Configure the billing port for the RADIGUS server.

set system login user admin.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class super-user.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication plain-text-password.explanation: The command `authentication [parameter3]` in Junos configures the authentication method or key for a protocol or interface, specified by `[parameter3]`.

parameters.name: authentication-method
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: Authentication method, such as plain-text-password.

unit 1.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

vlan-id 1.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.
